author: Zetetic I
title: Testing Refactored Model with Increased Capacity
abstract: This submission validates the modularized RNACNNWithAttention model imported from private storage (zetetic/models.py). It also tests the hypothesis that increasing model capacity will improve performance. The number of convolutional filters has been doubled from 128 to 256. This experiment aims to confirm the reusability of the stored code and to push the performance boundary of the current architecture.
